description: For each invalid fixture, the one rule it breaks. Every error the strict check reports for that file contains this text; a port can use the file to check that it rejects each fixture for the right reason.

invalid.motion-target-out-of-range.arec: must be a frame-relative coordinate between 0 and 1
invalid.pointer-out-of-range.arec: must be a frame-relative coordinate between 0 and 1
